page.overview:
Who is Fronk?

When initially approaches , he will be distant from him. He may ask to get out of his way. He might also be quiet for a moment, before he apologize to and explains that he was lost in thought.

After the is appeased by , can be found hammering a pillar in while conversing with himself. If speaks to him, will apologize and explain that he was talking to himself. says that after started rampaging, his wife went out to go fishing. Even though the is appeased, she still has not returned. wishes he had made her stay and wonders what he should do. If offers to find , expresses his gratitude and apologizes for placing this burden on him. This unlocks the "" . says he will help however he can to find .

If asks about , again says she is his wife and the mother of his children, and . He says she spends her days catching and selling them at the . describes as being very lively and cheerful, believing gets that from her. recalls that she was fishing in the , which began to swell from 's . He believes that the worst case scenario is that she was carried to .

Once has returned to , scolds his wife and tells her that she should not go wandering anymore for a while. is overwhelmingly appreciative towards and thanks him multiple times. If speaks to him again, calls him a true and thanks him in a more composed manner.
